title: Special purpose revenue bonds exempt from taxation.
bodyText: Special purpose revenue bonds and the income therefrom issued pursuant to this chapter shall be exempt from all state taxation, except inheritance, transfer, and estate taxes.
bodyHtml: §206M-12  Special purpose revenue bonds exempt from taxation.  Special purpose revenue bonds and the income therefrom issued pursuant to this chapter shall be exempt from all state taxation, except inheritance, transfer, and estate taxes. [L 1983, c 152, pt of §2; am L 2000, c 72, §16]
